questionText:
A person travelled a distance of 150 km and then returned to the starting point.
The time taken for the outward journey was 2&1/2 hours more than that for the return journey. His speed for the return journey was 10 km/h more than that for the outward journey. His speed for the return journey, in km/h, was:
solutionText: dist =( s1 - s2 / s1 * S2  )     * TIME DIFF
